case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 01 OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(CRIMINAL) NO. 2958 OF 2019)
summary: Circumstantial evidence analysis; last seen theory applied; motive of doubting wife's chastity unproved but irrelevant to burden of explanation; confession admissible in investigation; prosecution witnesses conflicted on marital discord; standard: chain of circumstances must be complete, no reasonable hypothesis except guilt; Section 106 Evidence Act burden not discharged; mental incapacity plea raised belatedly; post-conviction psychiatric treatment irrelevant to time of offence; concurrent findings upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction under Sections 302 and 201 IPC upheld; life sentence sustained.
